narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>For times one hundred one, write the number twice, side by side.
<bookmark mark='why'/>For a four digit number, that shifts it four places, not two.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The two rows overlap here, so we must add them with carries.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>To multiply by one hundred one, add the number to itself shifted two places.
<bookmark mark='hist'/>Bhaskaracharya wrote shortcuts like this in his book Lilavati.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Multiply two hundred thirty six by one hundred one, in one line.
